description: Join Megan Coy as we canvass Strongsville at Bonnie Park (Bonnie Park Dr, Strongsville, OH 44136) at 10:00 am on October 3rd. Even if you have no experience canvassing, all are welcome! Our team will help train you to door knock in this extremely pivotal race in Cuyahoga County.
